title: Cat's Cradle
author: Kurt Vonnegut
summary: A writer researching a book about the day the atom bomb was dropped tracks down the scientist's strange family. His quest takes him to a Caribbean island with its own invented religion and a dangerous substance.
readIf: you want a short, funny and bleak satire of science, religion and human folly.
skipIf: you want a plot-driven novel, since the book is a string of tiny chapters and wry digressions.

pairings.reason: The author's best-known novel, which has a similar deadpan tone and an even stronger sense of shock.
Another short, absurd science-fiction comedy about the foolishness of the universe.
Another satirical American classic in which dark humour is used to say what plain talk cannot.
